decisions.reason: Its dedicated presence over multiple years, close fit with the firm's dental materials business, and low incremental cost of serving existing laboratory channels make it worth keeping as a still-valuable option.
As a core-adjacent thermoforming material with its own page in successive years and clear synergies with the firm's established dental workflow offering, it merits continued support.

After several years the product showed only limited prominence, and with many stronger adjacent options in the portfolio the firm would likely reallocate resources rather than keep a weak ancillary material on the market.
Its disappearance from the website by 2019 is an early negative signal that likely resolved the option unfavorably, so management would abandon it and redirect effort to better-performing lines.
This product remains closely aligned with the firm's custom hearing-care capabilities and channels, and its continued presence indicates enough potential to justify staying in the market.
